expo.name: PitchIQ

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PitchIQ uses the camera to track your body's skeletal joints during drills. No facial geometry is collected, and tracking only starts after you give consent.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PitchIQ records audio only when you save a highlight clip.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PitchIQ saves highlight clips to your library so you can share them.
